PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
================================================================================

Sheikh Mujtaba is a highly skilled AI Developer and Security Engineer with expertise in building production-grade Agentic AI systems for business automation. With deep understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), security best practices, and full-stack development, Sheikh Mujtaba specializes in architecting RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, and secure AI infrastructure.
